ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, managers, and authorised signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list (EU Regulation 2020/1998 and related), French national freezing orders (Décret n° 2009-246), OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list for USD aspects, and French PEP databases (Tracfin/CNIL-compliant). Identity verification follows Article L. 561-10 CMF definitions with risk-based customer due diligence under Article L. 561-4-1.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), managed by INPI; availability search via Infogreffe (www.infogreffe.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The name must be written in Latin characters; French, foreign, or invented words are acceptable provided they are transliterated into Latin script. The name must not be contrary to public order or morality and must be distinctive within the relevant business sector.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant must obtain written grounds from the INPI. A 'recours gracieux' (administrative appeal) must be filed with the INPI within 30 days of rejection; if unsuccessful, the applicant may appeal before the Tribunal administratif within 2 months. Alternatively, a new name may be resubmitted after amending the articles of association.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office (domiciliation) is permitted for the registered office; however, a physical licensed production facility in France is mandatory for ISIC 1080 pet food manufacturing, for hygiene/sanitary approval and tax substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk: approximately 85% probability of an unannounced DGCCRF or veterinary inspection within the first 18 months of operations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L.227-1 to L.227-30 and R.227-1 et seq. on the simplified joint stock company (SAS), together with Code civil Articles 1832-1844-1 on company contracts and the implementing provisions of Law No. 66-537 of 24 July 1966.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce in the jurisdiction of the registered office, received electronically through the Guichet Unique operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: The corporate formation dossier on the official M0 form (immatriculation au Registre du commerce et des sociétés) accompanied by certified statutory articles of association and the prescribed annexes.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum share capital for an SAS; capital is freely fixed by the articles. Cash contributions must be transferred to a notary or an accredited bank account and held in escrow until the day the company is registered, after which the blocked funds are released. Contributions in kind require a statutory valuation report unless the de minimis exemption is unanimously waived.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the sole shareholder at the inaugural meeting held at [address] on [date]: (1) the draft articles of association are adopted in full; (2) share subscriptions are accepted and the capital contribution, as set out in the statuts, is fully subscribed and deemed paid up under Article L.227-1 et seq. of the French Commercial Code; (3) the registered office is fixed at [address] in the jurisdiction of [court]; and (4) [Name] is appointed as President of the SAS with powers specified in the articles, and [Name] as Director General, if applicable. The appointees hereby accept office in accordance with the law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, review and signature of the articles of association (statuts SAS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French avocat retained by the shareholders; notarization required if the contributions in kind include real property.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language statuts identifying the legal form (SAS), corporate name, registered office, duration, share capital and classes, governance bodies, decision-making rules, and the powers of the President and Director General. The corporate object must expressly cover the production, processing, conditioning and commercialisation of foodstuffs intended for feeding pet animals, including vacuum freeze-drying of raw meats. All shareholders or their legal representatives must sign every page. If shares are subscribed with non-cash contributions, appoint a statutory contribution auditor unless the de minimis exemption applies.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of all shareholders
Proof of address of each shareholder
Draft articles and deed of subscription
Declaration of beneficial ownership for the AML/CFT register
Contribution-in-kind report or sworn waiver
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry or legal reviewer identifies an inconsistency in the statuts, an amendment is executed by additional collaborative act and attached before filing. Any omission concerning the special powers of the President or share transfer restrictions is corrected in a separate récépissé before the M0 form is lodged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of cash share capital and issuance of the blocked-funds certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank operating in France, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, selected by the founding shareholder.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary company escrow account under the provisional corporate name, receiving cash subscriptions. The bank or depositary issues a capital deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt des fonds) that expressly blocks the funds until production of the RCS registration extract (Kbis). This certificate must be annexed to the M0 filing and kept until registration is completed.
required_dossiers: Identity of the subscribing shareholders
Draft statuts and share subscription table
Proof of transfer of funds
Provisional IBAN/BIC details of the escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses or delays, choose another credit institution and provide a new certificate. In an all-cash-based zero deposit case, submit a sworn statement by the sole shareholder confirming that no capital deposit was necessary, which is accepted by the registry if all contributions are made in kind or by clearing debts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the M0 incorporation dossier and payment of registry fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by INPI, with transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the official French electronic single portal and complete the M0 dossier. Attach the signed statuts, the capital deposit certificate or sworn statement, the registered-office lease or domiciliation agreement, the declaration of beneficial ownership, the President's acceptance of office and non-conviction declaration, and the corporate publication document. Pay the registry and infogreffe fees online. The portal transmits the dossier to the greffier, who verifies legal compliance and effects the RCS insertion, followed by issuance of the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: M0 form completed with SIREN/SIRET codes left blank
Original or certified copy of the signed statuts
Capital deposit certificate or sworn no-deposit statement
President's declaration of acceptance and non-conviction
Justification of domiciliation of the registered office
Specimen of the legal announcement to be published
Declaration of beneficial ownership
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is incomplete, INPI transmits a notice of non-receivability with a signed electronic QR; the user retries in the same portal after correcting the missing items within the indicated period. If the Greffe raises a legal irregularity, have the French attorney rectify the contract and resubmit, without waiting for an annulment action.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration completion, publication of the formation announcement and post-registration formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Infogreffe; DGFiP and social bodies indirectly through the SIRENE notification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Kbis is issued, verify the due publication of the formation announcement in an approved legal gazette (support d'annonces légales) and ensure the publication certificate is filed. Verify that SIREN, SIRET and the relevant coded classifications have been automatically forwarded to DGFiP and URSSAF. Open the final operating bank account by providing the Kbis, and appoint the President's representative to the bank signatory list. For the pet-food activity, submit the sanitary approval application to the DGAL/DDPP if the activity begins after registration.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract received after registration
Certificate of publication in the legal gazette
SIRENE/DGFiP registration summary
List of officers for social formalities
Bank KYC file with identity, domicile and beneficial-owner declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is challenged or the SIREN notification is delayed, a supplementary corrective announcement and a rectification filing with the Greffe are prepared. If the registry rejects an amendment, the attorney applies for an order from the supervisory judge of the commercial registry.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Générale de l'Alimentation (DGAL) of the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, implemented locally by the Direction Départementale de la Protection de la Population (DDPP); the competent workplace-safety authority is the Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agrément sanitaire européen pour établissement de préparation et de transformation d'aliments pour animaux familiers, pursuant to Regulation (EC) 1069/2009 and the French Code rural et de la pêche maritime; in justified low-capacity cases, a simple declared sanitary registration may be issued by the DDPP.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL), with DDPP control for water, waste and product compliance, within the ICPE permitting procedure under the French Environmental Code, Title I, rubrique 2260.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE registration (enregistrement) or simplified declaration (déclaration) depending on the installed cold-storage and meat-preparation throughput; for freeze-dried raw pet meat manufacture, no full EIA report is required below the high-capacity threshold, but an environmental compliance notice is lodged and a non-technical environmental statement is attached to the registration file when applicable.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must satisfy the general discharge standards of the Environmental Code: COD ≤ 125 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 25 mg/L, suspended solids ≤ 35 mg/L, pH 6.5-8.5; gaseous emissions and odours from raw-meat handling must respect workplace VME/VLE thresholds for ammonia and hydrogen sulphide; all animal by-products, fat and grease must be collected and directed to approved Category 3 processing routes in accordance with Regulation (EC) 1069/2009.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety approval by the Commission de Sécurité and the departmental fire service (SDIS), including alarm, extinguishers and evacuation planning; structural load certification for freeze-driers and storage racks; occupational clearance by the Labour Inspectorate after completion of a health-and-safety risk assessment, equipment compliance verification, and employee emergency training documentation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SAS entities obtain SIREN/SIRET identification from INSEE; VAT (TVA) identification number issued upon mandatory registration with DGFiP. Foreign-owned entities follow identical incorporation and registration process under French law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; French tax classification fixed by legal form under Code de Commerce and Code Général des Impôts. Hybrid mismatch rules governed by ATAD Directive.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €35,000 annual economic turnover threshold triggering mandatory VAT registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing under Facturation Électronique de Titre (FET) system; API integration with PEPITES platform for digital fiscal clearance and stamping on qualifying transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate on exports of goods outside the EU or qualifying intra-EU supplies; requires proof of actual export and non-reintroduction into France/EU.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU), Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties up to 80% of evaded VAT plus interest; retrospective clawback of zero-rating benefits if export documentation insufficient or goods re-enter France.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France, acting as the national central bank of the Eurosystem under the European Central Bank) exercises monetary policy, payments-market oversight and balance-of-payments data collection; foreign-exchange administration and international financial relations are handled by the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) under the Code Monétaire et Financier (Articles L.411-1 et seq. and R.152-7). The ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) is the prudential regulator licensing and supervising all French credit institutions and payment institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France provides full current-account and capital-account convertibility under Article 63 TFEU and Directive 88/361/EEC; the euro is freely convertible and there are no exchange-control approvals, surrender obligations or conversion quotas. Profit remittances (dividends repaid by the SAS to foreign shareholders, repayment of shareholder current accounts, royalties) are unrestricted as to amount and direction, subject to anti-money-laundering identification and reporting obligations (EU Regulation 2015/847 travel rule; FATF/ACPR standards) and, where applicable, French withholding taxes or double-tax-treaty reduced rates. Practical statutory constraints: any cross-border payment received by the SAS in excess of €12,500 triggers Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting (MESURE system) and therefore requires clear purpose codes; cash business-to-business settlement in France is capped at €1,000 per invoice under Article L.112-6 of the Code Monétaire et Financier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are none. Since the full liberalisation of French foreign-exchange controls (effective 1990), exporters such as the freeze-dried pet-food manufacturing SAS may keep export proceeds in EUR or any convertible currency without a repatriation deadline and without any mandatory conversion ratio. Compliance is limited to: (i) the automatic balance-of-payments declaration to the Banque de France by the bank for each transfer equal to or exceeding €12,500; (ii) the lodgement of export declarations with the French customs administration (DGDDI) via the Dematélisation single-window for animal-origin products; and (iii) documentary compliance with veterinary and health certification (TRACES) for raw-meat derived goods destined to non-EU buyers.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium — EU/EEA-authorised Electronic Money Institutions with an ACPR or passported e-money licence (EMD2/PSD2) are workable as supplementary rails for low-value marketplace receipts (e.g., Platform_Pay collection sub-account), with safeguarding of client funds in a segregated account; they cannot provide overdraft, trade finance, factoring, FX hedging or documentary-credit services, and French Tier-1 correspondent banks often refuse to open nostro accounts for EMIs, making the EMI non-operable for high-value injections and supplier LC disbursements. Offshore (non-EU) digital EMIs and neo-banks are not permitted to open payment accounts for a French-domiciled SAS unless they hold an ACPR branch licence (Articles L.526-3 and L.526-35 CMF); in practice, their non-standard KYC files and absence of a French establishment are underlying red flags under ACPR doctrine. Recommended structure: main treasury in a Tier-1 French bank, a passported EU EMI (Luxembourg/France/Lithuania licensed) for platform collections, with a daily auto-sweep of the EMI balance into the Tier-1 account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Market standard requires at least one in-person interview with the SAS legal representative (Président) or with a person holding a formal, notarised delegation (porteur de procuration) for the opening of the first account; fully remote opening is available only at a minority of institutions (BNP Paribas, Société Générale's professional video-KYC service) and only if the Président and all UBOs hold an EU biometric identity document verified through an ACPR-compliant digital identification service. Where any UBO is a non-EU resident, the norm is physical meeting plus a sworn translation (traducteur agréé) of corporate documents, an apostille on the certificate of incorporation, proof of address and a professional reference letter; certain banks may also require a registered-office verification visit to the French production plant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU resident Président or ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), especially where the individual's tax residence is in a FATF grey-listed or sanctioned third country, triggering enhanced due diligence under ACPR Article L.561-5 and financial-intelligence-unit reporting obligations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport copies; proof of address (less than 3 months old); personal tax-residence certificate (French non-resident attestation or foreign residency certificate); sworn source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statement in French; the UBO declaration filed with the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs and attached to the Kbis extract; and a reference letter from the legal counsel or accountant of the parent group.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection sourced from an intra-group loan or parent advance without full identification of the beneficial owner and with inconsistent transfer-pricing documentation, raising a money-laundering or hidden-commission concern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised share-subscription deed; executed intra-group loan agreement with arm's-length interest rate (French transfer-pricing file under Article 57 CGI); SWIFT MT103/MT202 with purpose code S211/F120; supporting bank statements and funds-flow chart; audited parent financial statements; and the transaction report automatically filed with Banque de France through the house bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ownership chain with one or more intermediate holding companies located in a zero-tax or opaque EU/offshore jurisdiction, blocking identification of the natural-person UBO.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified chain-of-ownership statement and extracts of each intermediate entity's share registry; where a trust or fiducie appears, the French trust register (Registre des Fiducies) filing or a civil-law notarial certification; consent letters from each intermediary releasing bank secrecy to the French bank; and a notarised attestation de transparence signed by all shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pet-food raw-meat import and export flow originating from third-country slaughterhouses or collection centres lacking the veterinary and customs documentation expected by the bank's sanctions and product-red-flag filters.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EU veterinary health certificates and TRACES notifications; EU approved-plant reference under Regulation (EC) 1069/2009 and Regulation (EU) 2017/625; freeze-drying processing and temperature logs; commercial invoices and packing lists from inspected suppliers; DGCCRF (French consumer and fraud-control authority) activity attestation; and customs export declarations (DAU) issued by DGDDI.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export destinations or trade counterparties bearing potential UN/EU/OFAC sanctions exposure, causing frozen transactions or refusal by the clearing bank's correspondent.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Institutionally maintained sanctions-screening policy; end-user certificates and destination-country import permissions; copies of passports or trade-register extracts of final consignees; contractual sanctions and non-proliferation warranties; and a complete record of EU and US sanctions list screening performed at each new counterparty onboarding.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Standard compliant routing: (i) the contributing shareholder issues a SWIFT MT103 transfer in EUR (TARGET2; if the sending bank is a third-country institution outside the EEA, SEPA is not available, so an MT202 COV correspondent leg is added to the parent bank's EUR nostro); (ii) remittance instructions must contain (a) the French balance-of-payments purpose code 'S211' for direct investment in an operating affiliate or 'F120' for intra-group loans, (b) the beneficiary identifier being the SAS name and IBAN of the operational treasury account, and (c) a reference to the capital-contribution or shareholder-loan contract. The receiving French bank will automatically file the MESURE balance-of-payments report to Banque de France when the transferred amount equals or exceeds €12,500; no prior authorisation is required. For contributions above €500,000, the bank expects the SAS to provide a certified decision of the associé unique (sole shareholder), the executed deed, and a notarised certificate of funds to evidence the legal origin; non-EUR injections are converted on the spot or pre-hedged, and any later FX sale generates a dealing ticket that serves as transfer-pricing evidence for tax purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For procurement of raw freeze-dried meat, packaging and logistics: (1) intra-EU/SEPA payments — SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (now capped at €100,000 per payment under the revised EU Instant Payment Regulation) for low-value invoices, with TARGET2 same-day settlement for high-value EUR; (2) third-country disbursements — SWIFT MT103 (cover method MT202 COV) over the bank's correspondent network, with US Dollar legs via Fedwire/CHIPS, GBP via CHAPS, and CNY via CIPS where the receiving bank maintains a renminbi account; (3) documentary trade — irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit issued by the French house bank under UCP 600 (with optional confirmation or silent confirmation for high-risk supplier geographies), standby L/Cs for supplier advance-payment risk, and documentary collections under URC 522 for frequent moderate-value parcels; (4) digital market rails — Platform_Pay and consumer-payment wallets may be used for sample sales and small-batch order collection, but cannot replace direct treasury payments above de minimis thresholds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward purchase and sale contracts (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CNY) for hedged commercial flows, with 1-24 month tenors under an ISDA 1998 FX or 2021 FX Definitions Master, provided the SAS demonstrates a real underlying exposure (Article L.211-40 CMF) and maintains a board-approved hedging policy

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted-delivery currencies (INR, KRW, TWD, ARS) permitted under ACPR market-conduct and EMIR rules where physical delivery is legally impossible, with daily mark-to-market and CSA-style collateralisation

Cross-currency swaps (fixed/fixed and fixed/floating EUR-USD, EUR-GBP) for structural hedging of shareholder loans, capex financing or multi-year export contracts, documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with Credit Support Annex and subject to EMIR clearing-threshold assessment by the French house bank

FX swaps (rollovers) and Tom/Spot swaps as short-term liquidity-bridging instruments between inbound foreign-currency export receipts and outbound EUR purchase orders, executed with the Tier-1 house bank at market-quoted swap points

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return and Annexes (Déclaration de Résultats: forms 2065-SD and 2050-SD series)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP – Service des Impôts des Entreprises (local corporate tax office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: FY ending 31 December: electronically by 3 May (2nd working day after 1 May); non-calendar fiscal years: within 3 months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Article 1728 CGI: late filing surcharge of 10%, increasing to 40% after 30 days from formal notice; late-payment interest of 0.20% per month under Article 1727 CGI; persistent default may trigger discretionary tax assessment and suspended loss carry-forwards

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts, Management Report and Director's Certificate filing (Dépôt des Comptes Annuels au RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique (Trade and Companies Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders approve accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end; deposit at the registry within 1 month of approval (for 31 December year-end: approval by 30 June, filing by 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Commercial Court injunction with daily astreinte and fine of EUR 1,500 under Article L.232-23 Code de commerce; filing default blocks dividend payments and tax clearance; repeated non-filing over 2+ years may trigger administrative radiation (strike-off)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Legal Representative's Integrity and Registry Data (Déclaration de Confirmation d'Intégrité)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Guichet Unique (National Directors Database)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually upon the registry's written invitation and within 1 month of that request; usually synchronized with the annual accounts filing cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation blocks issuance of the Kbis extract and interrupts commercial formalities; unresolved default may initialize the strike-off/radiation procedure for inactivity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: INPI Guichet Unique (transmitted to the Registrar / RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due within 1 month of the yearly confirmation request; any share transfer or UBO change must be declared within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 7,500 for individuals and EUR 37,500 for legal persons under Article L.561-46 Code monétaire et financier; Kbis application suspended until a conforming declaration is recorded

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Contribution Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) annual declaration and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP – local tax office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual return filed electronically with the income tax cycle; final CFE payment due 15 December of the tax year (minimum CFE based on turnover thresholds)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.20% per month plus 10% penalty (5% additional after enforcement notice); persistent default triggers enforced recovery against the SAS's bank accounts and assets

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a Commissaire aux Comptes when the SAS exceeds two of three thresholds at fiscal year-end: total balance sheet assets over EUR 4,000,000; net turnover over EUR 8,000,000; average workforce over 50 employees; audit also compulsory if the SAS controls one or more subsidiaries, or when required by minority shareholders (10%) or the Commercial Court President
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP – Plan Comptable Général (ANC Regulation 2014-03) for individual statutory accounts; IFRS mandatory for consolidated accounts of listed entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must maintain a Register of Beneficial Owners and file the UBO list at the RCS; any share transfer or change of direct or indirect control triggers a mandatory updating declaration within 30 days via the Guichet Unique; in addition, an annual confirmation of the UBO statement must be filed once per calendar year (normally with the annual accounts deposit) to keep the RCS record continuously accurate; omission is independently penalized under AML rules
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Securities Movements (Registre des Mouvements de Titres) evidencing share transfers
Register of Sole Shareholder and Shareholders' Meeting Minutes (Minute Book / Registre des Décisions)
Register of Corporate Acts, Delegations and Related-Party Agreements (Registre des Actes et Conventions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – USD 1,800 per annum: provincial registered-office domiciliation EUR 250–700; premium Paris registered-office and corporate-agent service EUR 600–1,600
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 15,000 per year for a first-year Commissaire aux Comptes engagement, depending on group structure, inventory cycles, and internal-control coverage

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate applicable from fiscal years commencing on or after 1 January 2022; reduced 15% rate on the first €42,500 of taxable profit available to qualifying SMEs)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on first €42,500 taxable profit (turnover ≤ €10M and ≥ 90% owned by individuals); carried-forward tax losses; R&D tax credit (Crédit d'Impôt Recherche - CIR) at 30% up to €100M and 5% above; patent box regime (Article 238 CGI) applying 10% effective rate on income from eligible IP; investment tax credit (Crédit d'Impôt Innovation - CII) at 20% of innovation expenditures; provisional exemption for new enterprises (exonération de plus-values jeunne entreprise innovante - JEI); no shareholder exit WHT on domestic dividends under the mother-daughter regime (95% exemption). Loss carryforward of fiscal deficits is unlimited in time (since 2019) but annually capped at €1M plus 50% of taxable income above €1M, unless the taxpayer opts for the 5-year carryback (carryback option limited to €1M per year; state refund of the carryback within 5 years).
